exact_statement: Let O_0=E_0=1, O_(n+1)=(2n+1)O_n and E_(n+1)=(2n+2)E_n. For all natural n>=1, E_n<=2n O_n, 1/(2n)<=O_n/E_n and 1/[2n(2n-1)]<=(O_n/E_n)/(2n-1). Also (2n)!=O_n E_n and E_n=2^n n!. For every rational t>=0 and natural N, the first N entropy-series coefficient terms times t^n sum to at most the first N square-root-series coefficient terms times t^n, as defined in JSCoefficients.lean.
hypotheses: exact recursively defined natural O_n,E_n and factorial
rational t>=0 for finite partial sums
no real-series, Fourier, Boolean or entropy assumptions in formal theorem
